title: Rosemary Beach "Blue Door Cottage" 121 Round Road Main House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Blue Door Cottage" 121 Round Road Main House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS- South of Hwy 30A and steps to private beach access- Private heated pool and jacuzzi spa. **Pool heating available for $35/day**- Short walk to Rosemary town square- Access to neighborhood pools and parks- Three primary suites- Flat-screen TVs in every bedroom- Outdoor kitchen- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Located south of 30A, Blue Door Cottage is a beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom property in Rosemary Beach that sleeps 12. Steps from private beach access, an adjacent boardwalk leads to the sandy shores, Coquina pool, and the Rosemary Beach shops and eateries. Enjoy the private pool and professionally decorated interiors—boasting new furnishings, light fixtures, refinished hardwood floors, and fresh paint!The heart of this 2-story seaside home resides on its second floor, adorned with new coastal furnishings and décor that sets the stage for a memorable vacation. The inviting great room is bathed in natural light, featuring vaulted ceilings and a spacious balcony that stretches across the front of the home. The beautifully furnished open living area boasts a large flat screen TV for movie nights, a powder bath and a designated workspace. The kitchen is a chef's delight with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, 2 additional refrigerator drawers, a walk-in pantry with a built-in microwave, and quartz countertops. A dining table seats 8 guests, with an additional 4 barstools at the kitchen island. On the balcony is a dining table that seats 8 and a comfortable sectional. The primary bedroom on this floor has a king bed, flat screen TV, and private bathroom with double vanities and a walk-in shower.The first floor boasts 2 primary bedrooms with king beds, plush bedding, flat screen TVs, and private bathrooms. Each bathroom has double vanities and a walk-in shower, while one also includes a gorgeous soaking tub. An adjacent bunk room has 2 twin-over-full beds, a flat screen TV, and its own bathroom with a shower/tub combo – a perfect space for kids! Amenities also include a washer and dryer. Doors open to a covered porch and stunning private courtyard with an outdoor kitchen, private pool, and sitting spa surrounded by lush green landscaping.The Blue Door Cottage will book quickly with its incredible location close to the beach and new, luxurious furnishings. With on-site parking—plus 3 complimentary adult bikes—it's easy to explore Rosemary Beach and Scenic 30A. Book this beach escape today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyPrimary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Freestanding Tub and ShowerGuest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyUnfortunately, the outdoor fireplace is not for guest use.
